question: As per the theory of demographic transition, the post-transitional stage of demographic transition is characterised by ______.

options.text: high and nearly equal birth and death rates
falling birth rates and high death rates
falling death rates and high birth rates
low and nearly equal birth and death rates

solution:
**The correct answer is: 'low and nearly equal birth and death rates'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **The post-transitional stage of demographic transition is characterised by low and nearly equal birth and death rates.**

 
 
• This statement is **correct.**
 
• The post-transition stage marks the stabilization of population
